motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active press on buttons. Disabled when prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.78 0.21 125); color: oklch(0.22 0.025 130); border: 2px solid oklch(0.22 0.025 130); border-radius: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.22 0.025 130); color: oklch(0.78 0.21 125); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.78 0.21 125); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A single-purpose tool that should feel like a shop stamp hitting paper: hard rules, no radius, one acid-lime mark.
keyCharacteristics: Acid lime on the logo and primary Strip actions only
2px ink rules, 0 radius, no drop shadows

rules.name: The Fill Rule
rules.body: Lime is a fill, not a text color.

rules.name: The One Cut Rule
rules.body: Accent appears on the mark, primary actions, focus, and drag-over.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow. No candy offsets. No glass.

dos: Do keep lime rare: logo, Strip, focus, drag-over.
Do use 2px full borders and 0 radius.
Do self-host IBM Plex and keep the privacy claim intact.
donts: Don't use forest-green / teal privacy-tool chrome.
Don't use rounded SaaS pills, glass, or soft shadows.
